     6	Streamlink is a CLI utility which pipes video streams from various services into a video player, such as VLC.
     7	
     8	The main purpose of streamlink is to avoid resource-heavy and unoptimized websites, while still allowing the user to enjoy various streamed content.
     9	
    10	Streamlink is a fork of the [Livestreamer][livestreamer] project.
    11	
    12	Please note that by using this application you're bypassing ads run by
    13	sites such as Twitch.tv. Please consider donating or paying for subscription
    14	services when they are available for the content you consume and enjoy.
    15	
    16	
    17	# [Installation][streamlink-installation]
    18	
    19	Please refer to our documentation for different ways to install Streamlink:
    20	
    21	- [Windows][streamlink-installation-windows]
    22	- [macOS][streamlink-installation-macos]
    23	- [Linux and BSD][streamlink-installation-linux-and-bsd]
    24	- [Source code][streamlink-installation-source]
    25	
    26	# Features
    27	
    28	Streamlink is built upon a plugin system which allows support for new services to be easily added.
    29	Most of the big streaming services are supported, such as:
    30	
    31	- [Twitch](https://www.twitch.tv)
    32	- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com)
    33	- [Livestream](https://livestream.com)
    34	- [Dailymotion](https://www.dailymotion.com)
    35	
    36	... and many more. A full list of plugins currently included can be found on the [plugin page][streamlink-plugins].
    37	
    38	
    39	# Quickstart
    40	
    41	After installing, simply use:
    42	
    43	```
    44	streamlink STREAMURL best
    45	```
    46	
    47	The default behavior of Streamlink is to play back streams in the VLC player.
    48	
    49	For more in-depth usage and install instructions, please refer to the [detailed documentation][streamlink-documentation].
